DESIGN BASIS — Source: Project documentation VM-ENG-204 Rev 4 (catalogue table and maker rules). Material: S355, f_y = 355 MPa, E = 210 GPa, G = 81 GPa, γ_M1 = 1.00. Member: 3.0 m pin-ended strut, L_ex = L_ey = L_ez = 3.0 m, warp-free twist restraint, load N_Ed = 115 kN through gross centroid. Section symmetry: x-axis of symmetry; y_0 = 0; x_0 from catalogue.

CATALOGUE SELECTION (Ask 1) — From the VM-C Series table in VM-ENG-204:
VM-C140: A=620, I_y=0.580e6, J=640, I_w=2.40e9, x_0=42.0
VM-C160: A=800, I_y=0.923e6, J=1067, I_w=5.30e9, x_0=49.0
VM-C180: A=1080, I_y=1.620e6, J=2590, I_w=13.50e9, x_0=55.4
VM-C200: A=1350, I_y=2.404e6, J=4500, I_w=28.50e9, x_0=62.0
All are Class 1–3 (A_eff = A). Check lightest upward.

EUROCODE 3 CHECK (Ask 2) — EN 1993-1-1 / EN 1993-1-3, γ_M1 = 1.00. Buckling curve b (α = 0.34) per maker rule 1. Slenderness limit λ_bar,max = 1.30 per maker rule 2. Twist knock-down k_VM = 0.92 because L_ez = 3.0 m > 2.50 m per maker rule 3.

SECTION PROPERTIES FOR VM-C180 (verified from catalogue):
A = 1080 mm²; I_y = 1.620×10⁶ mm⁴; I_x = 5.450×10⁶ mm⁴; J = 2590 mm⁴; I_w = 13.50×10⁹ mm⁶; x_0 = 55.4 mm; y_0 = 0.
r_y = √(I_y/A) = √(1.620e6/1080) = 38.7 mm.
r_x = √(I_x/A) = √(5.450e6/1080) = 71.0 mm.
r_0 = √(r_x² + r_y² + x_0²) = √(71.0² + 38.7² + 55.4²) = 98.1 mm.
β = 1 − (x_0/r_0)² = 1 − (55.4/98.1)² = 0.681.

ELASTIC CRITICAL LOADS (L = 3000 mm):
N_cr,y = π² E I_y / L² = π²·210000·1.620e6 / 3000² = 373.1 kN.
N_cr,T = (G J + π² E I_w/L²) / r_0² = (81000·2590 + π²·210000·13.50e9/9e6) / 98.1² = 345.3 kN.
N_cr,TF (coupled, β = 0.681) = (N_cr,y + N_cr,T)/(2β) · [1 − √(1 − 4β N_cr,y N_cr,T/(N_cr,y+N_cr,T)²)] = 229.3 kN (governing).

SLENDERNESS AND REDUCTION (Ask 3 — all maker rules applied):
N_cr = min(N_cr,y, N_cr,T, N_cr,TF) = 229.3 kN.
λ_bar = √(A f_y / N_cr) = √(1080·355 / 229300) = 1.293 ≤ 1.30 → PASS (maker rule 2).
φ = 0.5[1 + α(λ_bar − 0.2) + λ_bar²] = 0.5[1 + 0.34(1.093) + 1.672] = 1.522.
χ = 1/(φ + √(φ² − λ_bar²)) = 1/(1.522 + √(2.316 − 1.672)) = 0.430.
N_b,Rd = k_VM χ A f_y / γ_M1 = 0.92 · 0.430 · 1080 · 355 / 1.00 = 151.7 kN.
Utilization = N_Ed / N_b,Rd = 115 / 151.7 = 0.76 → PASS.

REJECTED LIGHTER SECTIONS (verified against same rules):
VM-C140: N_cr,TF ≈ 74.7 kN ⇒ λ_bar ≈ 1.72 > 1.30 → FAIL.
VM-C160: N_cr,TF ≈ 121.7 kN ⇒ λ_bar ≈ 1.53 > 1.30 → FAIL.
Therefore VM-C180 is the lightest VM-C profile satisfying all criteria.

|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| VM-C180 | 1080 | 38.7 | 98.1 | 373.1 | 345.3 | 229.3 | 1.29 | 0.43 | 151.7 | 0.76 |
